classification: Instrumented CPU cache-compression interaction and model-transfer study; substantial known prior-art overlap; novelty unestablished
question: When do context omission savings disappear against full-context prefix caching under repeated tables, longer contexts, arrivals and model transfer?

development.condition: Single predeclared alternative only if small-model full-context quality fails; same generated tasks permit bounded model comparison. Coordinate root first.

development_gate: Require each full-context baseline attempt at least95% exact task accuracy (8/8 in eight-request feasibility). If baseline fails, preserve complete adverse study and do not launch small-model confirmations. Any harmful omission remains visible.
prospective_confirmation_options: Small model record-reuse/context24 and64 strong both-cached comparison, seeds940129/940193.
At context64, full cache versus no cache and uncached dependency slice versus uncached full constituent controls, matched population/settings.
One predeclared paced/burst trace only after observed feasibility and before confirmation; all cold primers and table transitions retained.
Single14B strong cached comparison at one context as predeclared alternative, contingent on feasibility and shared budget.
matrix_limit: At most five512-offered-request measurements plus up to64 development offered requests=2624; options are conditional, not an instruction to execute all. A final finite matrix requires post-development root coordination and pre-confirmation freeze.
quality_rule: Both arms>=95% per attempt, no observed pair-level aggregate candidate accuracy loss, report all4pairedcorrectnessclasses. Same-input controls require token parity.
cost_rule: Primary full-attempt wall includes transformation, tokenization, backend/model verification, load and shutdown. Report service wall descriptively; include all shared setup, search, failed and historical costs once without counterfactual cache pooling.
stopping: Exactly frozen cells once. No automatic rerun, no filtering baseline failures, no gate relaxation. Stop before request/time/globaldeadline caps. Failed/interrupted native attempts retain costs and cancel remaining confirmation cells.
uncertainty: Two balanced AB/BA pairs; descriptive pair ranges only. Eight-query shared-table trajectories are dependent. No request-IID confidence or cross-device/population claim.
